method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; a seat-neutral core (wcin-wirc-2013.l4 and wcin-aca-1985.l4, one module per Act's notice, with the shared wcin-common.l4 and wcin-dates.l4) and two seat layers that restate no rule (wcin-seat.l4 for the injured worker, wcin-seat-family.l4 for the dependants and family of a worker who dies); no regulative rules, because the notice states no must, may or deadline; no REFUSE (a day outside 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2027, a row the notice does not print, or a combination of amounts the Act's formula decides answers `not covered`, asserted); figures encoded as printed, never recomputed; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Victoria Government Gazette No. S 363, Tuesday 30 June 2026 (Special), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/GG2026S363.txt (text sha256 04c8fe556bca3ef38185cf933965d9a6526da59cac06fb470eec02fe5945499a): the Workplace Injury Rehabilitation and Compensation Act 2013 notice (pages 11-18, text lines 389-733) and the Accident Compensation Act 1985 notice (pages 1-8, text lines 9-336); the 'Rate before 1 July 2026' column read as 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026 and the 'Rate from 1 July 2026' column as 1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027

checks.command: l4 run wcin-common.l4 ; l4 run wcin-dates.l4 ; l4 run wcin-wirc-2013.l4 ; l4 run wcin-aca-1985.l4 ; l4 run wcin-seat.l4 ; l4 run wcin-seat-family.l4 ; l4 run wcin-cases-worker.l4 ; l4 run wcin-cases-family.l4
checks.result: 351 assertions satisfied (219 in wcin-cases-worker.l4, 132 in wcin-cases-family.l4, of which 7 mirror cases), 0 errors, 0 warnings (2026-10-24)
checks.crosscheck: every pair of figures in the two Act modules appears on a row of its own notice in the deposited text, and every pair printed in each notice appears in its module except on the out-of-scope employer, insurer and self-insurer rows (script in the session scratchpad)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: In, the 2013 Act notice: weekly payments ss 161(a)(ii), 161(b)(ii), 162(a)(ii), 162(b)(ii), 163(2)(b), 164(1)(c), 165(4)(a), 165(5)(b), 166(1)(d); pre-injury average weekly earnings s 153(5) with Schedule 2 items 1 and 10, s 544 with Schedule 2 item 11; death s 236(1)-(6) (the shares as the rows state them), ss 237(1), 237(2), 237AA(1), 237A(1), 240(9); dependants' weekly pensions s 241(2)-(7); provisional payments s 243(1)(b); non-economic loss ss 211(2)(b)-(f), 212(b)-(e), 213(1)(a)-(e), 214(1), 214A(a)-(e), 217(1), (2); the no-disadvantage table s 221 with Schedule 4 (all 48 items) and s 221(4); medical and like services s 224(1)(b), (d), (e), s 229(4); dispute costs s 301(3), (4); damages s 340(a), (b), s 366(2). In, the 1985 Act notice: ss 92A(4)-(9), (11A), 92AA; s 92B(3)-(8) before and on or after 5 April 2010; s 92D(1)(b); ss 93A, 93B, 93C, 93CA(1)(c), 93CD(4)(a), (5), 93CDA(1)(d) by claim date and serious injury; s 98C(2)(e), (f), (3)(d), (e), (3B), (7), (8); s 99(1)(b), (d), (15); ss 134AB(22), 135A(7), 135C(2); s 5A(5) and s 100B with Schedule 1A items 1, 10 and 11. Inputs, because the parent Acts are not deposited: the governing Act, the claim date, the day that counts (for weekly payments, the day they were last indexed), pre-injury average weekly earnings and the uncapped weekly payment or pension, the entitlement period, current work capacity, serious injury, approval of an application, who is a dependant or orphan, the impairment rating and its description, 'T' and 'P', the formula amounts that combine a row's printed amounts, the Schedule 4 total, the s 134AB or s 135A choice. Out: the Workers Compensation Act 1958 notice (lines 338-387); every employer, insurer and self-insurer row (2013 Act s 106, s 72(1)(c), s 225(2), Schedule 6 cl 1(1), Schedule 7 cl 3(1), s 388(5); 1985 Act ss 99(5), 125(1)(a)(iii), 125A(3)(c), 129B(7)); the indexation arithmetic. Read with subjects/au/social-security-act-1991/encodings/baseline-2026-10/ (compensation, s 17 and Part 3.14 preclusion and recovery) and subjects/au/income-tax-assessment-act-1997/encodings/baseline-2026-10/ (weekly payments are income, s 6-5); cross-folder IMPORT is not possible.
seats: the injured worker (a claim under the Workplace Injury Rehabilitation and Compensation Act 2013, or under the Accident Compensation Act 1985 for an older claim)
the dependants and close family members of a worker who dies (and, for s 224(1)(d), the family of a severely injured worker)
